name: Copilot summary for subscriptions
description: Subscriptions delivered to your email are a great way to ensure that you don't miss reports which help you drive your business. With copilot summaries in the email, we do the heavy lifting for you and deliver the most important insights so that you can focus on acting on the insights instead of deriving them. Copilot summaries are optional and can be added as a part of the subscription setup for new or existing subscriptions.
